payment.lookup_prescription_for_pos.docstring:
Optional prescription lookup for POS checkout (Pull Model).

    Returns a cart payload with medication details, prices, and stock info.
    Does NOT modify prescription status or inventory.

    The response carries the patient name and every prescribed item, so it is
    prescription PHI. Every other prescription read in the application is
    role-gated; this one was the exception, and it was reachable by any
    authenticated account including a portal patient.

or.schedule_create.docstring:
Book a patient onto the theatre list.

    The blueprint previously exposed two GET routes and no writer, so
    SurgerySchedule - which has NOT NULL patient_id, procedure_name and
    scheduled_date - was populated by nothing. No surgery could be booked
    through this application at all.

    Only clinical roles may book; reception cannot, and a patient_id from another
    tenant is rejected rather than written.

    can set ``default_role`` to ``super_admin`` with ``auto_create_user`` on.
    That is a standing privilege-escalation primitive once the SSO login flow
    is enabled, so it is restricted to the platform owners rather than to
    anybody who is signed in.
